task.description: Run the full test suite for ISS-0829's fix (checkout feature/WF03-ISS0829-20260927, pull first). Docker Postgres (letflow-postgres-1, port 5462) should be healthy. Run: (1) mix test test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs -- quote real pass count; (2) TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 scripts/test_parallel.sh -- this is the load-bearing check since the original defect only manifested under full parallel-suite contention; ELIXIR-DEV's own attempt at this timed out at 580s in their environment (reported honestly, not a false claim) -- if it also doesn't complete for you within a reasonable window, run it as a true background process and poll rather than giving up, per docs/anti-patterns.md's guidance on long full-suite runs. Quote the real aggregated output. Structurally attribute any failures (git diff against origin/main per failing file) rather than assuming they're all pre-existing. Write a structured test report to test/reports/.
acceptance_criteria: Real command output quoted for both runs -- no speculation
The full-suite run actually completes (backgrounded + polled if needed) rather than being reported as timed-out without a real result
Any failures structurally attributed via git diff against origin/main on the specific failing file, not assumed pre-existing by count-matching
A structured test report written to test/reports/
PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL verdict; handoff completed per protocol (claim via IN_PROGRESS, then COMPLETED with a real result block)
